goal: Prevent a startup assertion crash during AssumeUTXO background sync when restarting with unlinked blocks
Avoid leaving nodes unbootable and forcing a full reindex that wipes snapshot chainstate
agreement: Strong support with testing confirming the fix prevents the startup crash
Verified fix on Windows x64 and reproduced assertion failure on revert (ValeraFinebits)
Verified fix against tests and crash on revert, asks if target_block->pprev can be null (Yudis-bit)

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it fixes a repeatable startup assertion crash during AssumeUTXO background sync
A node restarting with an out-of-order snapshot block becomes permanently unbootable without reindexing
